manifest.title: Bathing in Skyrim Renewed SN&SA Plugins
manifest.tagline: Dirtiness as a survival need, and a full bathing action tree for NPCs.
manifest.description:
Surfaces **Bathing in Skyrim - Renewed** dirtiness to SkyrimNet as a fourth survival signal alongside SeverActions' hunger, fatigue and cold, and gives NPCs a complete **Bathing** action category.

- Followers notice they are dirty, find water, walk to it on their own and bathe.
- Two-person washing: wash someone's back, offer or request a wash, accept or decline.
- Asking the player for the soap, water or privacy they are missing.
- Awareness events so onlookers and co-bathers know what happened.

Requires the mod **Bathing in Skyrim Renewed SN&SA Plugins**, which provides the Papyrus bridge these actions call into. The hygiene block only renders for a dirty, SeverActions-tracked follower, and is windowed so it does not appear in every request.
manifest.author: telord

mods.name: Bathing in Skyrim Renewed SN&SA Plugins

manifest.title: Courier Descriptions
manifest.tagline: The vanilla courier describes whoever handed him your mail - a generated line in his own voice that never reveals what the letter says.
manifest.description:
When the vanilla courier delivers an item he has no 'who sent it' voiceline for, he says a line about the person who handed it to him - in his own voice, in the per-item slot (between 'Let's see here...' and 'Looks like that's it'). He never says what the letter is about. When the sender is a real NPC and the letter names them, he describes the actual person, and how well he knows them scales with how well-known they are. Voiced deliveries (e.g. 'from Calcelmo') are left untouched.

This layer carries only the SkyrimNet content (the prompt). The mod's quest, dialogue lines and CDNBookText SKSE plugin ship in the same archive - install the full mod, not just this layer.
manifest.author: oldcustard
